description: This file defines a mock class WebAudioPlayerServiceMock for the IWebAudioPlayerService interface, used for unit testing web audio player services in the Rialto project. It includes mock method declarations for creating, destroying, controlling playback, and querying the state of web audio players.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServiceMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IWebAudioPlayerService for testing purposes, providing mocked methods for web audio player operations.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Mocks the creation of a web audio player with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Mocks the destruction of a web audio player identified by handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks the command to start playback on the specified web audio player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks the command to pause playback on the specified web audio player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Mocks setting the end of stream for the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Mocks retrieving available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Mocks writing data to the buffer of the specified web audio player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieving device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Mocks setting the volume for the web audio player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current volume of the web audio player.
